notes.title: New Features
items: Mirror notifications to WeChat after scanning a QR code in the menu bar
Choose from the menu bar whether notifications are also delivered to WeChat
Remember the WeChat pairing across Moof restarts
Restore WeChat delivery after inactivity without scanning another QR code

notes.title: Changes
items: The App Store build uses moof:// URLs instead of installing the command-line tool

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: The moof command line tool no longer fails with "executable is missing" when run from Terminal

notes.title: New Features
items: Floating notification cards triggered from the moof:// URL scheme or the moof command line tool
Default, Elden Ring, Mario and Hollow Knight themes, chosen in the menu or per notification
Cards persist until dismissed and report results back to the CLI
Install the CLI from the menu bar, or copy a prompt that teaches an AI agent to use it
